answers.H2_BQ1: On hydro frames, p95 surfaceField 3.40→3.40 ms (Δ 0.00); waterUpdate group p95 25.30→25.90 ms. The measured delta is small; coastline length alone did not produce a large surface-field cost.
answers.H2_BQ2: No increase in measured re-derivation cost or frequency: the detailed samples contained 109/600 E1 hydro frames and 95/600 E3 hydro frames, while VegetationUpdate p95 was 24.70→14.80 ms. Type changes p95 rose 84.00→167.00 and the frontier rose 4.00→1640.00 cells, but both maps already re-derive vegetation on hydro frames because height changes each step.
answers.H2_BQ3: 33.3 ms frame-CPU rate: standard 19.17%, archipelago 16.00%; canvas comparison: 6.00% vs 6.00%. The central-continent case had the higher threshold rate in this sample. E1 terrain/vegetation p95 was 17.60/24.70 ms versus E3 15.90/14.80 ms, while the water group differed by only 0.60 ms; added coast length alone did not predict tails.
answers.H2_BQ4: Yes as a deterministic stress fixture. Its higher water coverage, longer coast, multiple medium land components, and smaller dominant landmass extend the standard-map sample; it is not yet a measured worst-case bound for all future maps.
answers.C1: DOWNSTREAM_RENDER_DOMINANT; across Three hydro frames, mean direct step CPU was 15.50 ms and mean render CPU was 63.12 ms (4.07×). On center-continent E1, direct stepHydrology p95 was 19.50 ms per call, while render CPU p95 on hydro frames was 88.20 ms and summed PlaneStage layer-update p95 was 63.50 ms. Canvas E2 render CPU p95 on hydro frames was 18.40 ms despite a similar hydro step p95 of 17.10 ms; Three’s terrain/water/vegetation updates and WebGL submission explain most of that gap. The slow-frame rows retain direct hydro, update/render, bridge, layer, and submission times for each tail.
answers.C2: The fixture raises coast edges 3600.00→3976.00 and wet-vegetation frontier 4.00→1640.00 cells. Per hydro call, water changes p95 68969.00→90035.00 cells. On hydro frames, water-update p95 is 25.90 ms and vegetation p95 is 14.80 ms.
answers.C3: Keep it as a test fixture now. Treat it as a future start-world candidate only after the measured tail pressure is addressed; this H2 branch does not promote it to a product preset.
